source.author: verg
source.text: Nunquam hodie effugies; veniam, quocumque vocari audiat haec tantum vel qui venit ecce Palaemon efficiam posthac ne quemquam voce lacessas.
source.text_original: Nunquam hodie effugies; veniam, quocumque vocari / audiat haec tantum — vel qui venit ecce Palaemon / efficiam posthac ne quemquam voce lacessas.
source.text_english: You will never escape today; I shall come, wherever I hear myself called. Look, here comes Palaemon. After this I will make sure that you do not provoke anyone with your voice.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Numquam hodie effugies, veniam quocumque vocaris.
reuse.text_original: Numquam hodie effugies, veniam quocumque vocaris.
reuse.text_english: You will not escape today; I will come wherever I am called.
